data.narrative:
Vital Lyfe is a Seed-stage Climate & Energy company founded by Jonathan Criss and Andrew Harner that has raised $24M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix, alongside one public comparable (LNZA).

Stage-progression valuation applies a 2.5x multiplier to the $24M total raised proxy, implying a post-money valuation of $60M. This method is appropriate given Vital Lyfe's Seed stage and represents the most defensible analytical approach available. Peer-median triangulation was not applicable; while eight Climate & Energy companies exist in the comp universe, none satisfied the filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparables—a threshold of three or more datapoints is required for reliable median derivation. A broad-sector median would introduce material noise and bias.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $51M to $69M, centered on $60M, derived from the single applicable methodology. The primary uncertainty stems from limited comparable transactions at this stage within the Climate & Energy vertical, constraining calibration of appropriate step-up multiples. Additionally, the narrow public peer set (one ticker) provides limited market-based pricing validation. Further validation through recent Series A outcomes in deep tech climate would strengthen conviction in this range.
